name: Residual Boundary Algebra completion space — four-front block refinement

newly_fixed_or_constrained.statement: The six-value partial WDL symbolic carrier is exactly representable by four nested monotone endpoint threshold fronts: lower>=D, lower>=W, upper>=D, upper>=W.
Those four fronts compose exactly through the tested two-ply Bellman block on arbitrary monotone q-dependent partial-information assignments.
Passing only the four-front interface between two-ply blocks remains exact through tested four- and six-ply compositions.
The same chained representation preserves root fixed-action partial-value fronts required for exact best-move recovery.
The two-ply symbolic Bellman transformer is generally neither a join nor meet homomorphism on input fronts.
The non-homomorphic excess is caused by mixed opponent-reply covers created by distributivity of universal reply conjunction over input alternatives.

refined_candidate_core.transition_layer: terminal-extended left adjoints with right adjoints
refined_candidate_core.block_operator: alternating lattice polynomial using preimage, union, intersection, and terminal constants
refined_candidate_core.strong_distance: resolution ordinal of exact W/D/L/U refinement

refined_open_region.question: Can the board-fiber + adjoint + four-front alternating lattice-polynomial basis be reduced further?
What parameter bounds the number of minimal mixed opponent-reply covers produced by block composition?
Can the alternating union/intersection transformer be normalized output-sensitively without enumerating the Cartesian family of reply-choice combinations?
Can composed front transformers be fused/exponentiated into a compact empty-root normal form without materializing intermediate fiber fronts?
Are four nested fronts minimal for full six-value action/state partial information, or is there a smaller compositionally closed encoding?
Is the mixed reply-cover normal form the exact ordinary-value projection of the proof/controllable-predecessor seam, and what relation does it have to C4-R0043/C4-R0069/C4-R0076?

current_localization: The remaining RBA core is the compact/output-sensitive representation of mixed reply-cover terms generated by alternating lattice-polynomial composition, plus possible fusion of those transformers across the board-fiber graph.
